name: notte
description: Browser automation and AI agent skills for Notte. Run real cloud or local browsers, scrape JavaScript-rendered pages with Pydantic-typed output, drive multi-step workflows behind auth and captchas, and deploy any browser automation as a scheduled, API-callable Notte Function. Use when building browser automations, web scraping pipelines, or agent-driven web workflows.

plugins.name: notte
plugins.description: Drive a real cloud or local browser with Notte. Manage browser sessions and accounts from the Notte CLI, explore a site once and deploy it as a reusable Notte Function, and diagnose or repair a failing Function.

plugins.name: notte-migrate
plugins.description: Opt-in. Cost-compare another browser automation provider against Notte from a codebase, telemetry, or invoice, and migrate to Notte with a measured, reversible rollout.
